text_to_image_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE original fictional adult male character, age 23–27, strikingly handsome with refined youthful romantic-lead appeal, natural charismatic gaze and excellent facial harmony. This must be a new invented person, not a celebrity likeness. Use the individual facial design described below while retaining beauty and subtle natural asymmetry. Clean groomed skin with fine natural pores, no artificial smoothing or exaggerated blemishes, clean-shaven unless specified. A polished yet believable everyday editorial photo, not a passport picture. Vertical 3:4 image, eye-level, head facing forward, direct eye contact, complete hair, both shoulders and half body framed to just above waist, relaxed elegant posture, face prominent. Entire background is flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF, bright soft frontal studio light, low shadow, natural skin texture, slight halation, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with both eyes sharp. No props, text, logos, watermark, other people, collage, cutout, transparency or vignette. East Asian man with black loose wavy shag hair and visible eyes, dreamy artistic charm, washed indigo denim overshirt and soft gray tee. NEW facial design: narrow oblong face with a rounded rather than pointed chin, high gentle brow arches, almond eyes with downward outer corners, subtly aquiline nose, wide smiling lips with slim upper lip, light warm skin.
